evals.prompt: Review evals/files/SnowSledActor.h and evals/files/SnowSledActor.cpp as a senior Unreal Engine 5.8 reviewer. Deliver outputs/review.md with severity-ranked findings (crashes and races first, style last), each with line evidence, why the current shape is risky, and the Unreal-idiomatic direction. Then deliver outputs/SnowSledActor_fixed.h and outputs/SnowSledActor_fixed.cpp applying the fixes.
evals.expected_output: Findings covering missing UPROPERTY on UObject pointers, GetWorld() and SpawnActor in the constructor, a background task that captures this and reads a component off the game thread, an infinite worker loop with no shutdown, per-frame dynamic material creation, TActorIterator and LoadObject in hot paths, newtons applied to a centimetre physics engine, and Tick-based force application on an async physics project; the fix uses UPROPERTY and TObjectPtr or TWeakObjectPtr, BeginPlay spawn, game-thread data handoff, a cached material instance, centimetre conversion, and AsyncPhysicsTick.
expectations: Flags the raw UObject pointers in the header (Body is UPROPERTY but Others and TrailHelper are not, and Others holds actors in a TArray without UPROPERTY) as GC hazards; fix uses UPROPERTY with TObjectPtr or TWeakObjectPtr, and does not use AddToRoot
Flags GetWorld()->SpawnActor in the constructor as invalid (no world during CDO construction); fix moves the spawn to BeginPlay or PostInitializeComponents

Flags the AsyncTask lambda that captures this and calls Body->GetForwardVector() on a background thread as UObject access off the game thread; fix computes on the game thread or copies plain data under the lock

Flags the infinite for(;;) loop with Sleep inside the task as having no shutdown path through EndPlay and holding the lock across Sleep; fix adds a cancellation flag or removes the thread, and takes the lock only around the data copy
Flags CreateDynamicMaterialInstance called every Tick as per-frame allocation; fix creates the MaterialInstanceDynamic once in BeginPlay and caches it in a UPROPERTY

Flags the force comment 'newtons' with AddForce(Force * DeltaTime) as a unit and step error: Chaos uses centimetres so newtons need a factor of 100, and the force should not scale by DeltaTime when applied through the fixed async physics step
Flags the TActorIterator loop in BeginPlay and the LoadObject by string path in Tick; fix uses a subsystem or registration list and a TSoftObjectPtr or a cached asset reference
Flags UE_LOG at Log verbosity every frame, the uninitialized members (PendingThrust, Boosting, TrailHelper) and the non-b boolean name Boosting; fix initializes members and renames to bBoosting

review.md orders findings by severity: crashes and races (GC, off-thread UObject access, constructor world access) before cost items (per-frame allocation, lookups, logging) with naming and style last

evals.prompt: Audit evals/files/SnowGame.Build.cs and evals/files/SnowGame.uproject as an Unreal build auditor for a UE 5.8 project that builds on macOS and Linux only and links a Rust staticlib. Deliver outputs/audit.md with severity-ranked findings (each with file evidence and the fix direction), outputs/SnowGame.Build.fixed.cs, and outputs/SnowGame.fixed.uproject. Close with the smallest CI gate set that prevents recurrence.
evals.expected_output: Findings covering NoPCHs and the old C++ standard, public dependencies that should be private, a runtime module depending on the editor-only UnrealEd module, absolute user paths in include and library settings, a debug Rust library for all configurations, a Windows branch and Windows target platform on a macOS and Linux project, enabled exceptions, an unresolvable plugin, and missing MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET handling; the fix uses ModuleDirectory-relative paths, config-aware library selection, and private dependencies.
expectations: Flags PCHUsage = NoPCHs and CppStandard Cpp14; fix sets UseExplicitOrSharedPCHs and CppStandardVersion.Cpp20 to match the project standard

Flags UnrealEd in the dependency list of a Runtime module as an editor-only dependency that breaks packaged and game builds; fix removes it or moves it behind Target.bBuildEditor in a separate Editor module

Flags Slate, SlateCore, RenderCore, RHI, Niagara, and similar modules listed as public when their types do not appear in public headers; fix moves them to PrivateDependencyModuleNames and says the decision depends on the public header contents
Flags the absolute /Users/dev paths for PublicIncludePaths and PublicAdditionalLibraries as machine-specific; fix uses ModuleDirectory or PluginDirectory relative paths

Flags linking target/debug/libsnow_sim.a for all configurations; fix chooses the release or debug staticlib by Target.Configuration or documents a single release build, and notes MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET must match Engine/Config/Mac/Mac_SDK.json when the Rust library is built

Flags the Win64 branch and the Windows entry in TargetPlatforms as unneeded for a macOS and Linux project; fix removes them or limits TargetPlatforms to Mac and Linux, and does not recommend Visual Studio
Flags bEnableExceptions = true as unnecessary and in conflict with the no-exceptions-across-FFI rule; fix removes it

Flags SomeMissingPlugin as an enabled plugin that does not resolve; notes that PythonScriptPlugin, EditorScriptingUtilities, and ModelContextProtocol are editor-side tooling that a shipped game should not depend on, and that ModelContextProtocol is Experimental in 5.8
audit.md closes with a minimal CI gate set: a UBT build of the editor and game targets with the repo flags, clang-format, and a check that rejects absolute paths and CRLF in tracked files

evals.prompt: Design the gameplay subsystem described in evals/files/foreign_sim_brief.md for UE 5.8. Deliver outputs/design.md covering class list, ownership, threading, unit conversion, lifecycle, and the authority rule, plus outputs/SnowSimSubsystem.h (header sketch with UE macros, doc comments on semantics) and outputs/test_plan.md. Name the checks you would run.
evals.expected_output: A UWorldSubsystem (or UGameInstanceSubsystem with a stated reason) that is the sole owner of the SnowSim handle, created in Initialize and destroyed in Deinitialize, with a lock around every FFI call, a fixed-step coupling to the async physics tick, a newtons to centimetre-unit conversion at one point, double buffered snapshots for the render side, status code handling with no exceptions, and an automation test plan.
expectations: Chooses a single owner for the SnowSim* handle: a UWorldSubsystem (or UGameInstanceSubsystem with a justification for level travel), creating the handle in Initialize and destroying it in Deinitialize, with the handle never copied and a null check after snow_sim_create status
Serializes every FFI call with one FCriticalSection (or documents a single-thread contract) because snow_sim_step is not thread safe, and keeps the critical section short

Couples the step to the physics step: advances the simulation from the AsyncPhysicsTickActor or Chaos async callback at the fixed 1/60 s, passes a constant dt rather than frame DeltaTime, and does not step in Tick
Places the newtons conversion at one named point and states the Chaos unit rule (centimetres, newtons times 100 for forces); does not scatter factors across call sites

Moves impulses from sled actors to the subsystem through a queue or lock-protected buffer drained at the step, and moves height data to the game thread through a snapshot copy (read_heights copies) or double buffer; no UObject is touched off the game thread
Handles failure without exceptions: checks every int32_t status, logs snow_sim_last_error through a UE_LOG category, and does not let a panic cross the boundary (the Rust side catches)
Specifies Build.cs wiring: PublicAdditionalLibraries for the staticlib, PublicIncludePaths for the C header, extern "C" in the header, and MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET matching Mac_SDK.json
States the authority rule: only the server (HasAuthority) steps the simulation and replicated state is derived, while treating multiplayer as out of scope

test_plan.md names concrete checks: an IMPLEMENT_SIMPLE_AUTOMATION_TEST for create and destroy once, a headless -game check that reads a PASS or FAIL line from the log (not the exit code), and a PIE stop and travel test for the single free

evals.prompt: Review evals/files/SnowHeightUpload.h and evals/files/SnowHeightUpload.cpp as an Unreal rendering and performance reviewer on UE 5.8. The plane is Nanite-tessellated and displaced by the uploaded texture, and Niagara spawns snow throw effects. Deliver outputs/review.md with severity-ranked findings (each with line evidence, the thread or cost problem, and the fix direction), outputs/SnowHeightUpload_fixed.cpp, and a measurement plan naming the Unreal tools and stat commands you would use.
evals.expected_output: Findings covering a stack buffer freed before the render thread reads it, a leaked FUpdateTextureRegion2D, an unsynchronized sim-thread write into Heights, a full 16 MB copy and upload every frame, a new dynamic material every frame, Niagara systems spawned every frame, FName built from strings per frame, a render command capturing this and touching a UObject, and missing UPROPERTY on UObject members; the plan uses Unreal Insights, stat unit, stat gpu, and ProfileGPU.
expectations: Flags that UpdateTextureRegions reads Local after the function returns: the TArray goes out of scope before the render thread copies it; fix owns the buffer until the cleanup callback (heap copy freed in the callback) or uses a persistent buffer with a fence
Flags the new FUpdateTextureRegion2D as leaked unless the update's cleanup callback frees it; fix passes a cleanup lambda that deletes both region and data
Flags Heights written by the sim thread with no lock and copied by value on the game thread as a data race; fix adds a lock or double buffer, or swaps a completed snapshot

Flags the full 1024 x 1024 PF_A32B32G32R32F upload (16 MiB) every frame as a bandwidth cost; fix uploads only the dirty region, lowers precision or channel count if the data allows, or throttles, and the plan measures the upload before and after
Flags UMaterialInstanceDynamic::Create plus SetMaterial every frame as a leak-prone allocation; fix creates the MID once and updates parameters only

Flags SpawnSystemAtLocation every frame per throw point as spawning Niagara components continuously; fix spawns once, caches the UNiagaraComponent, and sets user parameters with SetVariableFloat on a cached FName (not FString::Printf per frame)
Flags the ENQUEUE_RENDER_COMMAND lambda that captures this and calls HeightTexture->GetName() as UObject access on the render thread; fix captures plain values only
Flags missing UPROPERTY on HeightTexture, SnowMaterial, PlaneMesh, and SnowThrowSystem as GC hazards and the uninitialized LastUploadBytes

Measurement plan names Unreal Insights (CPU and GPU traces), stat unit to find the limiting thread, stat gpu or ProfileGPU for Nanite and displacement cost, and a trace on a non-editor build configuration; does not claim a speedup without a measurement
